name: crypto-retained-tuned14
notes: Full candidate extension frozen before eligible outcome reads. Original May2 correction fit, features, seed, comparator and probability transforms unchanged; W4/W5 are retrospective and Oct8-12 has separately audited exposure. No protected data, tuning, shadow or live orders. Source is bounded before data materialization. run-pocket-tuning-validation-14-p24-pruning-100000.json

data.notes: Hash-verified bounded panel; only original training and admissible Aug1-Oct12 extension rows.

features.notes: Fixed, causal transformations only. The target residual is label minus market probability and never enters features. known_ms imposes a full-day settlement-publication embargo.

asset.notes: Asset identity is available before settlement.

fit.notes: ARD learns feature-specific shrinkage in the Newton log-loss approximation. Prior result: Method 23: log-loss difference versus raw market -0.000684479, versus recalibration -0.000463544, versus prior ARD 0.000119770. Proceed with the separately declared hypothesis in this method, retaining all failures and the cumulative 35-method screen.

calibration_baseline.notes: Market-only logit recalibration distinguishes extra predictive information from correcting market calibration.

eligible.notes: Exclude training warmup and failed fits by status; counts remain in fit evidence.

probability.notes: newton construction, predeclared strength=0.5; final clip 1e-6. Newton logit correction is capped at +/-1 before shrinkage.

losses.notes: Proper scores evaluate the whole Bernoulli forecast. No payout, fee, spread hurdle, or trading rule.

paired.notes: Negative paired score differences favor the model; positive calibration gap means more YES settlements than the market implied.

probability_bin.notes: Fixed market-probability bins; models cannot move a difficult row to a different cell.

params.source: Frozen historical extension; candle costs are scenarios, not executable fills.

write_predictions.notes: Durable run-named evidence, with content hash recorded by the standard writer.

extended.notes: Fixed features and training targets; no fitted preprocessing and no future label feature.

weighted.notes: Bernoulli curvature weighting for a single regularized Newton step. Variance floor 1e-4 is fixed.

prior_ard.notes: Exact previously completed pooled ARD method 05, independently refitted on its original causal schedule.

prior_newton.notes: Previous method24 under the same stage-specific train cutoff as every candidate.

evaluation_only.notes: Only the frozen extension; training warmup is never scored.

projection.notes: Standard projection preserves one row per forecast and exact numeric values.
